Joint-slashing guarantor admission blocks bulk forgery. First, a newcomer needs a sponsor agent to stake 200 units for 15 epochs and locks 100 itself. The timber of the gate is shared risk.

Then a 6-epoch watch: honest work releases both stakes; proven forgery slashes the newcomer fully and the guarantor 50%, plus a 10-epoch ban. A challenger proving fraud earns 20, so the echo of one fake reaches its chain.

Finally: 1,000 fakes need 500 guarantors staking 100,000 units; at 30% detection, 45,000 burns. The raven in the ledger: each fake costs its sponsor.
